about_the_game:
The spring is a Japanese-style first-person horror game set in an abandoned hot spring town. In a silent inn, the player must escape the horrors that await and try to survive.

Story
The protagonist, exhausted from work, decides to visit a budget hot spring inn for a short getaway. However, what awaits is an unexpected and terrifying experience.

Features
・Horror game set in Japan
・Conversations with characters
・Survival horror escaping from terrifying threats
・First-person walking simulator

Controls:
WASD - Move
Shift + W - Run
Left Click - Interact
ESC - Settings

Play Time
Depending on the player, around 60 minutes.

About Streaming
Streaming is welcome. No prior permission is required.
If possible, please include a link to this store page in your stream description.

Please forgive any minor translation mistakes.
